title: Dollar Tree Attracts Higher-Income Customers as Sales Climb 7%
summary:
Dollar Tree continues to attract middle-income and higher-income shoppers as consumers deal with inflation. The discount retailer reported earnings Thursday (Aug. 27) showing its total sales for the second quarter climbing 7%. “The consumer environment remains dynamic,” CEO Mike Creedon said during an earnings call. “Customers continue managing household budgets carefully, shopping with purpose and prioritizing value and affordability.” […]
The post Dollar Tree Attracts Higher-Income Customers as Sales Climb 7% appeared first on PYMNTS.com.
content: Dollar Tree continues to attract middle-income and higher-income shoppers as consumers navigate persistent inflation. The discount retailer reported that its total sales for the second quarter climbed by 7 percent. Leadership noted that the consumer environment remains dynamic, with customers carefully managing household budgets, shopping with purpose, and prioritizing value and affordability.

title: Ethena Foundation proposes fee switch for ENA token buybacks among other updates
summary: Ethena Foundation announced four updates, including buying locked ENA tokens and ending future monthly investor unlocks.
content: The Ethena Foundation has proposed a new fee switch mechanism designed to fund ENA token buybacks. Alongside this proposal, the foundation introduced a total of four key updates for the ecosystem. These changes notably include plans for purchasing locked ENA tokens and bringing an end to future monthly investor token unlocks, aiming to alter the token's circulating supply dynamics.

title: This Is Why Arthur Hayes Thinks AI Agents Need Their Own Money
summary: AI agents would pay for computing power using the token, therefore directly linking its demand to network usage.
content: Arthur Hayes has suggested that autonomous artificial intelligence agents will require their own native money to function effectively. According to this perspective, AI agents could utilize cryptographic tokens to pay directly for essential computing power. This mechanism would create a direct link between token demand and the actual usage of the underlying network, shaping how automated systems might interact with digital economies in the future.
